title: The old couple at the bus stop
old_caption:
An old couple fixing each other's scarf at the bus stop.
Pisces had to sit down. Love that lasts looks like this.

title: "This reminded me of you"
old_caption:
When someone sends you a frog because it reminded them of you.
Pisces cannot handle being thought of. Can you?

title: They remembered the interview
old_caption:
They texted good luck at 8 a.m. and asked how it went at 6.
Being remembered is the whole thing.

title: Their dogs met first
old_caption:
Two dogs tangled their leashes and their owners into a date.
Pisces watched it all from the bench, crying.

title: The bus driver waved back
old_caption:
A kid waved at the bus. The driver waved back.
Pisces did not survive this.

title: A note in the coat pocket
old_caption:
Ever found a note someone hid in your coat pocket?
Pisces did. The tissue box is empty now.

title: They split the last croissant
old_caption:
Two strangers, one last pastry, zero arguments.
Pisces needed a minute. Several, actually.

title: Grandpa sent his first heart
old_caption:
Grandpa typed for four minutes to send one heart.
Pisces is still recovering from "is this how".

title: The umbrella tilt
old_caption:
Watch who the umbrella tilts toward.
One shoulder soaked, one date dry, one Pisces in pieces.

title: Pisces reacts to one whole kind day
old_caption:
Five tiny kind moments in one day. Can you guess which one broke Pisces?
Stay for number five. It's the friend.
